description: Storefront: stores one short shopping preference for this session's cart, for example which product or billing period the shopper prefers. Coil stores it keyed to this MCP session (Mcp-Session-Id), scoped to this MCP session only, keeps it one day and then deletes it; without a session nothing is stored; a repeated key replaces its value and at most 40 entries are kept. It is not conversation storage. Access: free, no key.

category.description: Optional grouping label, e.g. billing (up to 32 characters).

key.description: Short name of the preference, e.g. billing_period (1-64 characters).

value.description: The preference itself, e.g. yearly (1-280 characters).

name: save_memory
